moments.text: Handheld night recording of a dark, grainy sky; nothing visible yet.
A pair of small red lights swings in from the left as the camera moves, smeared into short double streaks.
The camera steadies on the pair: two tiny red dots side by side just left of centre, drifting slowly down.
The camera keeps panning: small pairs of red lights drift in and out, often two or three pairs in view at once.
The view zooms in and the picture turns coarse; one pair of lights becomes two distinct red dots, low centre.
Zoomed in, the pair shakes around the frame, flickering between red and white, sometimes smeared into streaks by camera motion.
The lights leave the frame; only coarse dark noise for about three seconds.
The view zooms back out; the camera pans across several small red light pairs, two or three in view at a time.
